literal_meaning: দেবের পুরী (gods' city or divine abode)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার নতুন বাড়িটি দেবপুরীর মতো সুন্দর হয়েছে।
এই মন্দিরটি একেবারে দেবপুরী বলে মনে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His new house looks like a devapuri, so exquisitely beautiful.
This temple feels like a divine city, utterly magnificent.
history: Refers to mythical divine cities in Hindu mythology, such as Indrapuri, symbolizing heavenly beauty in Bengali literature.
note: Commonly used in poetic or admiring contexts to evoke celestial grandeur.
